This pattern matches climatological baselines near 69 °F yet frequently produces lower observed highs when the marine layer persists through midday. Warmer bins above 68 °F carry lower implied odds because any shift to offshore winds or clearer skies would need to overcome the dominant Pacific influence before the observation window closes. Traders are therefore weighting the most probable range based on current forecast consensus rather than outlier warming scenarios.
